budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sewer rates for FY11 rose 20%, but revenue is projected to rise 15% because bills are sent quarterly.
budget_items.quote: rates for fy11 have increased 20% but since bills don't go out until the end of the quarter, revenue increases 15%.
late fees are increased from $5 to $10.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrant article will appropriate revenues and retained earnings totaling $574,235.26.
budget_items.quote: warrant article will include appropriating $482,233.55 from revenues and $92,001.71 from retained earnings, for a total of $574,235.26.

budget_items.topic: Sewer inflow and infiltration and Fitchburg/Leominster billing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A one-time expense to address inflow and infiltration was noted; costs could rise significantly if Fitchburg and Leominster bill on sewer meters, and Fitchburg's rate double-charges residents for capital upgrades. No dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: concern is that costs could go up significantly if fitchburg and leominster exercise their right to bill based on sewer meters

budget_items.topic: FY2010 budget amendment and Meadowwoods expense
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Karen Brochu reported that an FY10 budget amendment is needed, with a transfer from the Sewer Betterment Fund to cover the Meadowwoods expense; no stabilization appropriation is needed now.
budget_items.quote: $188,354.89 is needed to amend the fy10 budget, with $155,945 transferred from the sewer betterment fund to cover the meadowwoods expense.

budget_items.topic: Free cash and snow and ice
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Karen Brochu raised a concern that free cash may not cover snow and ice costs. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: we may not have enough free cash to cover snow and ice.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager recommends appropriating a FY11 Omnibus Total as of 4/27.
budget_items.quote: town manager recommends appropriating $25,844,659 for fy11 omnibus total as of 4/27.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: PEC voted to accept a shift to 77.5/22.5 effective July 1, 2010, potentially reducing health care expense by $111k including schools.
budget_items.quote: potentially reducing health care expense by $111k total including schools.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The budget gap was closed to $26k and then grew by $186k to $212k due to added special needs expense.
budget_items.quote: as of our last meeting, the gap had been closed to $26k. that gap has grown by $186k to $212k due to added special needs expense.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Agreement to level fund schools, with additional unemployment expense coming from stabilization. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: dave and mark reported that we had agreed to level fund schools, with additional unemployment expense coming from stabilization.
